# FFmpeg WebAssembly files

This directory contains browser bundles used by the local `Видео ↔ GIF` tool:

- `@ffmpeg/ffmpeg` 0.12.15 (`ffmpeg.js` and `814.ffmpeg.js`), MIT License;
- `@ffmpeg/core` 0.12.10 (`ffmpeg-core.js` and `ffmpeg-core.wasm`), GPL-2.0-or-later.

The bundles are served from the AKD Image origin and run in the user's browser. Source code and build instructions are available in the official [ffmpeg.wasm repository](https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/v0.12.15). FFmpeg's own licensing information is included in `LICENSE.FFmpeg.md`.
